tasks.objective: Implement the PO-requested Umami measurement using the existing account and public website ID a0f3bd66-07fc-4082-956d-70c17ff621c5, under the previously agreed minimal marketing contract: public landing visit and successful Demo initialization only. Do NOT paste a global default auto-tracking script. Prefer the officially documented POST https://cloud.umami.is/api/send collector with a tiny first-party audited module so third-party code is not executed inside authenticated teacher pages. No paid API/key/upgrade is required for this public collector. The provider still sees network IP/User-Agent and may derive technical/location metrics; do not call this zero data or zero risk. Add a concise truthful public privacy explanation of limited events and external Umami processing (provider docs state US/EU servers), without claiming a verified region for this specific account or blanket legal compliance.
acceptance: Only landing_view after the public anonymous landing is actually rendered, and demo_started after ordinary Demo workspace initialization succeeds (not on button click). Never track authenticated accounts, account provisioning, classrooms, grades, reports, support, backup, deletion, settings navigation, internal route IDs or page titles. Unknown/initial auth state must not be treated as anonymous. Recheck eligibility at send time and cancel pending sends when entering account mode. Preview/localhost are disabled.

Use a hardcoded event allowlist and construct a new payload from safe constants, not a spread of location/document/account objects: website ID, canonical production hostname, constant public URL '/' and public title, event name. Omit referrer/screen/device identifiers/custom session IDs and all user/teacher/student fields. No umami.identify, cookies, fingerprint code, session replay, heatmaps, automatic route/click/form/error tracking. Browser-sent IP/UA at the collector cannot be claimed absent.

UTM is optional and strictly allowlisted to known marketing source/medium vocabulary; reject unknown values, emails, IDs, long or free-text fields and do not forward raw query/hash or arbitrary campaign content. Dedupe each of the two events once per tab session using booleans only; no persistent user identifier. Respect Do Not Track/Global Privacy Control. No requests while offline, no replayed analytics outbox or retry loop, no user-visible error/toast and no blocking login/Demo/Sync when the collector is slow or blocked.

For direct collector fetch use credentials:'omit', referrerPolicy:'no-referrer', timeout/cancellation and safe exception handling. Add only the exact needed connect-src host to CSP, never weaken other directives or allow script wildcards. Register any new first-party module needed for app startup in the existing offline shell; the collector must not become an offline boot dependency. Do not download/repackage a font or add analytics packages.

Synthetic unit/actual UI request-capture checks prove public landing once, successful demo once, failed demo zero, authenticated/unknown state zero, internal route and PII-bearing query zero leakage, DNT/GPC zero, Preview zero, blocked collector no app regression. Inspect exact outgoing JSON and CSP. One actual ordinary public visit can verify a collector response after deployment, but do not spam fake events or claim dashboard counts/API access not observed. Source proof versus remote dashboard observation must be separated.

Read official primary docs already reviewed: https://docs.umami.is/docs/api/sending-stats (Cloud collector no auth token), https://docs.umami.is/docs/tracker-configuration (auto tracking defaults), https://docs.umami.is/docs/sessions (derived session hash), https://umami.is/terms (US/Germany and incorporated DPA), https://umami.is/pricing (Hobby100K events,1website,6months; no new subscription). Preserve full app functionality and do not replace core account/Sync code.
